note: Rules for Directions on Norwegian Getaway (1.16.0, names and the Either limit since 1.16.2). Costs are in seconds and set how routes are chosen; tips are the one-line hints under the steps. Edit this file to change them, then run python tools/build_index.py.

either.note: Since 1.16.2: in Either mode a route uses the stairs for at most this many decks in a row (up or down, counting stairs joined by a walk across a deck), then the elevators. When no route fits (the elevators don't reach that deck), it takes the stairs anyway. Stairs mode and the Advanced limits don't use it.

names_note: Friendly names for stairways and elevator banks, by their id in walkable/index.json. A name is used only while that id serves exactly these decks, so a renumbered id in a later import falls back to the plain name (and the release check fails).

tips.text: Elevators are busiest just after arrival. Stairs may be quicker.
Debarkation morning: elevators are packed with luggage. Stairs are usually quicker.
Mealtime at the {place}: {bank} are farther from it and take about as long.
